transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I've just been feeling incredibly down and sad for the past month. It feels like a constant, heavy depression that I just can't seem to shake.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days or longer when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual? This would help me know if your depression might be part of bipolar disorder.

No, I’ve never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods where I felt unusually energetic, euphoric, or needed less sleep. It's actually been the exact opposite—I just feel completely down and exhausted all the time.

Before this past month, had you been feeling down most days for at least 2 years, or did this start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life? That will help me tell whether this is a long-standing depression or more tied to a recent stressor.

I don't think I've had any long-term issues like this before, as I felt okay until recently. These feelings really just started about a month ago, and I can't think of any specific stressful event or major change that triggered it.
Along with feeling down, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed a loss of interest in my usual activities, I just feel too down and exhausted to do much of anything.
Over the past month, have you had changes in your sleep or appetite, trouble concentrating, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

My sleep has been a mess this past month; I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly or too early, sometimes sleep too long, have nightmares, and still feel exhausted. However, I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite, my concentration, or felt any worthlessness or guilt.
Even if it didn’t seem major at the time, did anything stressful happen in the 3 months before this started, like problems with work, relationships, health, or finances?

I really can't recall any specific stressful events or major changes in my life, work, or relationships right before this started. Everything seemed to be going normally, so these feelings just seemed to come out of nowhere.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I don't want to hurt myself or end my life, and I don't feel like life isn't worth living. I'm just feeling incredibly down and exhausted all the time.
During this past month, have you felt slowed down in your body or movements, or had low energy nearly every day?

Yes, I've definitely felt physically slowed down, as if my body is incredibly heavy and all my movements are sluggish. My energy has been extremely low nearly every day, making even simple daily tasks feel like a massive chore.
How much has this been affecting your daily functioning, like your work, self-care, or relationships?

My daily functioning has been heavily impacted because I feel a severe loss of energy and constant physical and mental fatigue. Even basic daily activities feel like a massive chore, and it has been very hard to focus or get anything done. I haven't really tracked how it is affecting my relationships, though.
Before this started, were there any new medications, alcohol or drug use, or medical problems like thyroid issues that could be affecting your mood or energy?
No, I haven't started any new medications, and I don't drink alcohol or use drugs. I also don't have any known medical conditions, like thyroid issues, from before all of this started.
